content: EqEmb are based on word embeddings BIBREF5 or specifically Bernoulli embeddings (b-embs) BIBREF1 . Word embeddings models the probability of a word INLINEFORM0 given its context INLINEFORM1 as a conditional distribution INLINEFORM2 where the context is defined as the set of words INLINEFORM3 in a window of size INLINEFORM4 that surrounds it. In word embeddings each word is assigned to two types of latent feature vectors, the embedding ( INLINEFORM5 ) and context ( INLINEFORM6 ) vectors, both of which are INLINEFORM7 dimensional.
